summary: Infosys Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, disclosing its quarterly results of operations and financial condition for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing attaches press releases, a fact sheet, earnings call transcripts, and audited financial statements under IFRS and Ind AS. No special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, recapitalization, or restructuring is present. The filing is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer and does not trigger any special-situations category.
